module: Reads and modifies the paint (RGBA color, metallic, roughness) of a livery editor layer, found by its uid in editor_api_dynamicDecals. It also provides the current vehicle model's preset paints. It is used by the UI's paint screen and by the decals editor.
notes: All values coming from the UI are normalized between 0 and 1: an out-of-range value is clamped, a non-numeric value is replaced by the layer's value.
setLayerPaint works on a deep copy of the layer and calls setLayer(updatedLayer, true), so as not to pollute the API history.
A layer linked to a vehicle color palette (colorPaletteMapId not nil) goes back to palette 0 as soon as its paint is modified here.
Fill layers have neither metallicIntensity nor roughnessIntensity: these fields stay nil in getLayerPaint and are ignored by setLayerPaint.

EDITABLE_COLOR_PALETTE_MAP_ID.desc: Equals 0. This is the only mode where a layer displays its own color; any other id takes the color from a vehicle palette slot and ignores the layer's.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before this one: editor_api_dynamicDecals.

getVehiclePaintPresets.desc: Returns the model.paints list of player 0's vehicle model (via core_vehicles.getModel), or an empty table if there is no vehicle. Shared with the decals editor.

readNormalized.desc: Converts value to a number and clamps it between 0 and 1; returns fallback if the conversion fails.

fallback.desc: Value returned if value is not numeric.

getLayerPaint.desc: Returns the paint of the layer with the given uid: layerUid, color {r, g, b, a} (white by default), metallic, roughness and presets. Returns nil, with a warning, if the uid is not a string or the layer does not exist.

setLayerPaint.desc: Applies color, metallic and roughness to the layer with the given uid, via a copy of the layer passed to editor_api_dynamicDecals.setLayer. Returns false if the layer is not found or paint is not a table.

paint.desc: Optional fields color {r, g, b, a}, metallic, roughness, all normalized between 0 and 1.

returns.desc: true if the update was done.
